description: [Kyreos, 1 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Send up to 100 URLs. For each URL you get the HTTP status, whether it answers a valid x402 402 challenge, the price it asks and the latency. Built for x402 sellers who need to find dead or misconfigured paid routes before buyers do. Input: {"urls":["https://your-host/route1","https://your-host/route2"]}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/x402-reprobe-batch?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (1 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (1 USDC on Base)

name: kyreos_x402_reprobe_batch
title: x402 Route Re-Probe, 100 URLs
